content: We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1738 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need number of C=O groups. Could be more than one but only one strong carbonyl peak. Others are aromatic C-H etc. Likely one carbonyl. Could confirm with carbon NMR maybe but IR suggests one. Use carbon NMR to see number of carbonyl carbons (around 190-210 ppm). Let's get carbon NMR.
